detailed_descriptions.en: TURN YOUR WEBCAM INTO AN EYE TRACKER Look around naturally with head and eye tracking in hundreds of PC games. No extra hardware. Works with your webcam or phone. Scan Your Cockpit, Check Mirrors, Look Behind You with Head & Eye Tracking Hands stay on the wheel or stick. The in-game camera tracks your head and eyes naturally. Built for Sim Gamers and Streamers Sim racers track mirrors mid-corner. Flight pilots scan instruments mid-flight. Truckers and farmers watch the road, mirrors, and dashboard at a glance. Streamers share their gaze with viewers. Use Your Webcam or Phone. No tracker hardware required. Any standard webcam works, built-in or external. No webcam? Use your phone. Try Before You Buy Try the demo first with full feature access. 3 hours of active tracking. Remove the limit with a one-time purchase, no subscription. Supports Hundreds of Head and Eye Tracking Games A selection of compatible games across flight, space, racing, driving, trucking, farming, combat, FPS, and other simulator genres. The full game list is available on our website Driving, Trucking, and Farming Check side mirrors, watch the road, glance at the dashboard and GPS. Euro Truck Simulator 2 American Truck Simulator BeamNG.drive Farming Simulator 25 Farming Simulator 22 Bus Simulator 21 Train Sim World 5 Space Simulation Look around the ship, track targets, check your radar. Star Citizen Elite Dangerous Star Wars: Squadrons X4: Foundations Kerbal Space Program Flight Simulation Look around the cockpit, check instruments, scan for traffic and threats. DCS World Nuclear Option Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 Microsoft Flight Simulator X: Steam Edition X-Plane 12 X-Plane 11 Top Gun: Maverick Expansion IL-2 Sturmovik AeroFly FS 2 Racing Simulation Check your mirrors, spot the competition, look through the corner. A wider field of view without lifting your hands off the wheel. Le Mans Ultimate Assetto Corsa Assetto Corsa Competizione Automobilista 2 F1 25 F1 24 F1 23 F1 22 iRacing rFactor 2 Project CARS DiRT 3 FPS and Combat Lean around corners, scan rooms, check your six. War Thunder Arma 3 Arma Reforger DayZ Insurgency Get Started in Minutes (1) Install Beam → (2) Run the Guided Setup → (3) Launch your game Game setup guides on our website cover every supported game. Support page with troubleshooting for anything else. IMMERSIVE CAMERA Webcam Eye Tracking Eye tracking to control your in-game camera with no dedicated hardware. Supports 60 FPS or higher on compatible webcams for smoother, lower-latency tracking. 6DoF Head Tracking Yaw, pitch, roll, plus lean forward, sideways, and up. Use it on its own or combined with eye tracking. Direct Game Camera Control Games see the Beam Eye Tracker directly. No third-party software running alongside. Phone as a Webcam Use your phone via Android or iOS built-in options. For Face ID iPhones, the dedicated Beam Eye Tracker iOS app runs tracking on your phone so your PC stays free. Hotkeys Pause, resume, and recenter tracking without leaving your game. Assign any key or button on your peripherals. Demo Profiles and Community Profiles Built-in Demo Profiles get you tracking right away. Adjust sensitivity, smoothing, and eye/head blend to match how you play. Access Community Profiles on the Steam Workshop after purchase for a head start. EYE TRACKING OVERLAY Stream Where You Look : Show viewers exactly what catches your eye in real time. Makes your reactions easier to follow and turns gameplay moments into stronger clips. Customize color, opacity, and size. Hide it on your screen while OBS or Streamlabs captures it. Review Your Focus : Record gameplay with gaze data to spot what you missed. Improve faster. E-Sports Training : The Minimap Awareness Trainer extension helps you build better map-checking habits. PRODUCTIVITY & PRIVACY Use eye tracking outside of games: Multi-Screen Pointer : cursor follows your gaze across monitors. Mouse Jump : hotkey teleports your cursor to where you're looking. Privacy Filter : blurs parts of your screen you're not looking at. Presence Detection : locks your screen when you step away. · · · We Protect Your Privacy All processing happens locally on your device. No biometric data is generated or stored. We're based in Switzerland, home to some of the world's strictest privacy laws. Frequently Asked Questions What webcam do I need for the Beam Eye Tracker? For most users, a standard 720p webcam, built-in or external, is a cost-effective and instant option. It offers solid performance and simple setup at 30 FPS. You can also use free apps that turn your phone into a webcam. Test the Demo first. Make sure you are happy with the app before buying any hardware. If the demo does not run, contact us for help. Does the Beam Eye Tracker work with glasses? Yes. Most users with glasses have no issues. Strong prescriptions or glare from lenses can reduce accuracy slightly, and thick frames may block your eyes at certain angles. If that happens, try positioning your webcam below the monitor instead of above it. Try the Demo first to see how it works with your glasses. How do I set up the Beam Eye Tracker with my game? Most games work automatically. Start the Beam Eye Tracker, launch your game, and the in-game camera will respond to your head and eye movements. A few games (like Star Citizen, F1, and Farming Simulator) need a quick in-game setting change. Check the game setup guides for game-specific instructions. Does the app collect biometric data? No, the Beam Eye Tracker does not generate or store any biometric data. Join the Community Help shape what we build next. Share feedback on Discord or in the Steam Community Hub. Our SDK is open to developers who want to build their own extensions. Browse the Extensions page on our website to see what's already out there.

iOS应用会在手机上进行追踪，让你的PC更轻松。 热键 无需离开游戏即可暂停、恢复和重新居中追踪。可分配到外设上的任意按键或按钮。 演示档案与社区配置文件 内置演示档案让你立即开始追踪。根据自己的玩法调整灵敏度、平滑度和眼/头混合比例。购买后可在Steam创意工坊使用社区配置文件，让你抢先一步。 眼动叠加层 把你的视线直播出去 ：实时向观众展示吸引你目光的内容。让你的反应更易于追踪，让游戏瞬间变成更出彩的剪辑。可自定义颜色、不透明度和大小。当OBS或Streamlabs捕获时，可在自己的屏幕上将其隐藏。 复盘你的专注度 ：用视线数据记录你的游戏过程，找出你漏掉的细节。更快进步。 E-Sports训练 ：Minimap Awareness Trainer扩展帮助你养成更好的小地图查看习惯。 生产力与隐私 游戏之外也能使用眼动追踪： 多屏指针 ：光标会随着你的视线在多块显示器之间移动。 鼠标跳转 ：通过热键将光标瞬移到你正在看的位置。 隐私滤镜 ：将你没有看的屏幕区域进行模糊处理。 在席检测 ：当你离开时自动锁定屏幕。 · · · 我们保护你的隐私 所有处理都在你的设备本地进行。不会生成或存储任何生物特征数据。我们的总部位于瑞士，这里拥有世界上最严格的隐私法律之一。 常见问题 Beam Eye Tracker需要什么样的网络摄像头？ 对大多数用户来说，一台内置或外接的720p标准网络摄像头是性价比高、立即可用的方案，在30 FPS下提供扎实的表现和简单的设置。你也可以使用免费应用，将手机变成网络摄像头。 先试用演示版。在购买硬件之前先确认这款应用是否适合你。如果演示无法运行，请联系我们获取帮助。 Beam Eye Tracker戴眼镜也能用吗？ 可以。大多数戴眼镜的用户没有问题。高度数眼镜或镜片反光可能会略微降低精度，过粗的镜框在某些角度下可能遮挡眼睛。出现这种情况时，请尝试把网络摄像头放在显示器下方而不是上方。 先试用演示版，看看戴着眼镜效果如何。 如何在游戏中设置Beam Eye Tracker？ 大多数游戏都能自动工作。启动Beam Eye Tracker，启动游戏，游戏内镜头就会跟随你的头部和眼睛动作。少数游戏（如Star Citizen、F1和Farming Simulator）需要快速调整一下游戏内的设置。具体步骤请参考游戏设置指南。 这款应用会收集生物特征数据吗？ 不会，Beam Eye Tracker不会生成或存储任何生物特征数据。 加入社区 帮助我们决定下一个版本要做什么。在Discord或Steam社区中心分享你的反馈。我们的SDK向希望开发自己扩展的开发者开放。访问网站上的Extensions页面，看看已经有哪些扩展。

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
TURN YOUR WEBCAM INTO AN EYE TRACKER

Look around naturally with head and eye tracking in hundreds of PC games. No extra hardware. Works with your webcam or phone.



Scan Your Cockpit, Check Mirrors, Look Behind You with Head & Eye Tracking

Hands stay on the wheel or stick. The in-game camera tracks your head and eyes naturally.


Built for Sim Gamers and Streamers

Sim racers track mirrors mid-corner. Flight pilots scan instruments mid-flight. Truckers and farmers watch the road, mirrors, and dashboard at a glance. Streamers share their gaze with viewers.


Use Your Webcam or Phone. No tracker hardware required.

Any standard webcam works, built-in or external. No webcam? Use your phone.


Try Before You Buy

Try the demo first with full feature access. 3 hours of active tracking. Remove the limit with a one-time purchase, no subscription.

Supports Hundreds of Head and Eye Tracking Games

A selection of compatible games across flight, space, racing, driving, trucking, farming, combat, FPS, and other simulator genres. The full game list is available on our website

Check side mirrors, watch the road, glance at the dashboard and GPS.

Look around the ship, track targets, check your radar.

Look around the cockpit, check instruments, scan for traffic and threats.

Racing Simulation

Check your mirrors, spot the competition, look through the corner. A wider field of view without lifting your hands off the wheel.

  • Automobilista 2

  • F1 24
  • F1 23

FPS and Combat

Lean around corners, scan rooms, check your six.

  • War Thunder
  • Arma 3
  • Arma Reforger

  • Insurgency

Get Started in Minutes

(1) Install Beam → (2) Run the Guided Setup → (3) Launch your game

  • Game setup guides on our website cover every supported game.
  • Support page with troubleshooting for anything else.

IMMERSIVE CAMERA


Webcam Eye Tracking

Eye tracking to control your in-game camera with no dedicated hardware. Supports 60 FPS or higher on compatible webcams for smoother, lower-latency tracking.


6DoF Head Tracking

Yaw, pitch, roll, plus lean forward, sideways, and up. Use it on its own or combined with eye tracking.


Direct Game Camera Control

Games see the Beam Eye Tracker directly. No third-party software running alongside.


Phone as a Webcam

Use your phone via Android or iOS built-in options. For Face ID iPhones, the dedicated Beam Eye Tracker iOS app runs tracking on your phone so your PC stays free.


Hotkeys

Pause, resume, and recenter tracking without leaving your game. Assign any key or button on your peripherals.


Demo Profiles and Community Profiles

Built-in Demo Profiles get you tracking right away. Adjust sensitivity, smoothing, and eye/head blend to match how you play. Access Community Profiles on the Steam Workshop after purchase for a head start.


EYE TRACKING OVERLAY


  • Stream Where You Look: Show viewers exactly what catches your eye in real time. Makes your reactions easier to follow and turns gameplay moments into stronger clips. Customize color, opacity, and size. Hide it on your screen while OBS or Streamlabs captures it.
  • Review Your Focus: Record gameplay with gaze data to spot what you missed. Improve faster.
  • E-Sports Training: The Minimap Awareness Trainer extension helps you build better map-checking habits.

PRODUCTIVITY & PRIVACY


Use eye tracking outside of games:

  • Multi-Screen Pointer: cursor follows your gaze across monitors.
  • Mouse Jump: hotkey teleports your cursor to where you're looking.
  • Privacy Filter: blurs parts of your screen you're not looking at.
  • Presence Detection: locks your screen when you step away.


· · ·

We Protect Your Privacy

All processing happens locally on your device. No biometric data is generated or stored. We're based in Switzerland, home to some of the world's strictest privacy laws.

Frequently Asked Questions

What webcam do I need for the Beam Eye Tracker?

For most users, a standard 720p webcam, built-in or external, is a cost-effective and instant option. It offers solid performance and simple setup at 30 FPS. You can also use free apps that turn your phone into a webcam.

Test the Demo first. Make sure you are happy with the app before buying any hardware. If the demo does not run, contact us for help.


Does the Beam Eye Tracker work with glasses?

Yes. Most users with glasses have no issues. Strong prescriptions or glare from lenses can reduce accuracy slightly, and thick frames may block your eyes at certain angles. If that happens, try positioning your webcam below the monitor instead of above it.

Try the Demo first to see how it works with your glasses.


How do I set up the Beam Eye Tracker with my game?

Most games work automatically. Start the Beam Eye Tracker, launch your game, and the in-game camera will respond to your head and eye movements. A few games (like Star Citizen, F1, and Farming Simulator) need a quick in-game setting change. Check the game setup guides for game-specific instructions.


Does the app collect biometric data?

No, the Beam Eye Tracker does not generate or store any biometric data.

Join the Community

Help shape what we build next. Share feedback on Discord or in the Steam Community Hub. Our SDK is open to developers who want to build their own extensions. Browse the Extensions page on our website to see what's already out there.

Beam Eye Trackerはメガネをかけていても動作しますか？

はい。メガネ着用のユーザーの多くは問題なく利用しています。強い度数やレンズの反射で精度が少し下がる場合があり、太いフレームでは特定の角度で目が隠れることがあります。その場合は、ウェブカメラをモニターの下に配置してみてください。

まずはデモを試して、メガネ環境での動作を確認してみてください。


ゲームでBeam Eye Trackerをどう設定すれば良いですか？

ほとんどのゲームは自動で動作します。Beam Eye Trackerを起動し、ゲームを起動すれば、ゲーム内カメラが頭と視線の動きに反応します。一部のゲーム（Star Citizen、F1、Farming Simulatorなど）はゲーム内設定の簡単な変更が必要です。ゲームごとの手順はセットアップガイドをご覧ください。


アプリは生体データを収集しますか？

いいえ、Beam Eye Trackerは生体データを生成・保存しません。

コミュニティに参加

次に何を作るか、一緒に決めましょう。DiscordまたはSteam Community Hubでフィードバックをお寄せください。当社のSDKは独自拡張機能を作りたい開発者に開かれています。すでに公開されている拡張機能は、公式サイトのExtensionsページをご覧ください。

자주 묻는 질문

Beam Eye Tracker에는 어떤 웹캠이 필요한가요?

대부분의 사용자에게는 내장형이든 외장형이든 일반 720p 웹캠이 비용 대비 효과가 좋고 즉시 사용 가능한 옵션입니다. 30FPS에서도 충분한 성능과 간단한 설정을 제공합니다. 스마트폰을 웹캠으로 만드는 무료 앱도 사용할 수 있습니다.

Beam Eye Tracker는 안경을 써도 작동하나요?

먼저 데모로 안경 환경에서 어떻게 작동하는지 확인해 보세요.


게임에서 Beam Eye Tracker를 어떻게 설정하나요?

대부분의 게임은 자동으로 작동합니다. Beam Eye Tracker를 실행하고 게임을 실행하면, 게임 내 카메라가 머리와 시선의 움직임에 반응합니다. 일부 게임(Star Citizen, F1, Farming Simulator 등)은 게임 내 설정을 간단히 변경해야 합니다. 게임별 지침은 설정 가이드를 참고하세요.

아니요, Beam Eye Tracker는 어떠한 생체 데이터도 생성하거나 저장하지 않습니다.
